tools.name: list_users
tools.description:
List all users in Proxmox.

Args:
    enabled: Only show enabled users.
    full: Include detailed info (groups, tokens, etc.).

tools.name: get_user
tools.description:
Get details for a specific user.

Args:
    userid: User ID (format: 'user@realm', e.g. 'admin@pam').

tools.name: create_user
tools.description:
Create a new user.

Args:
    userid: User ID (format: 'user@realm', e.g. 'myuser@pve').
    password: Password (only for pve/pam realms).
    email: Email address.
    firstname: First name.
    lastname: Last name.
    groups: Comma-separated group list.
    comment: Description.
    enable: Enable user.
    expire: Account expiration (Unix epoch, 0 = never).

tools.name: update_user
tools.description:
Update an existing user.

Args:
    userid: User ID (format: 'user@realm').
    email: Email address.
    firstname: First name.
    lastname: Last name.
    groups: Comma-separated group list.
    comment: Description.
    enable: Enable/disable user.
    expire: Account expiration (Unix epoch, 0 = never, -1 = don't change).
    append: Append groups instead of replacing.

tools.name: delete_user
tools.description:
Delete a user.

Args:
    userid: User ID to delete (format: 'user@realm').

tools.name: list_user_tokens
tools.description:
List API tokens for a user.

Args:
    userid: User ID (format: 'user@realm').

tools.name: get_user_token
tools.description:
Get details for a specific API token.

Args:
    userid: User ID (format: 'user@realm').
    tokenid: Token ID.

tools.name: create_user_token
tools.description:
Create a new API token for a user. Returns the token value (shown only once).

Args:
    userid: User ID (format: 'user@realm').
    tokenid: Token ID (alphanumeric).
    comment: Token description.
    privsep: Enable privilege separation (token has own permissions, not user's full permissions).
    expire: Expiration (Unix epoch, 0 = never).

tools.name: delete_user_token
tools.description:
Delete an API token.

Args:
    userid: User ID (format: 'user@realm').
    tokenid: Token ID.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List all user groups.

tools.name: get_group
tools.description:
Get group details.

Args:
    groupid: Group ID.

tools.name: create_group
tools.description:
Create a new group.

Args:
    groupid: Group ID.
    comment: Description.

tools.name: update_group
tools.description:
Update a group.

Args:
    groupid: Group ID.
    comment: Description.

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description:
Delete a group.

Args:
    groupid: Group ID.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List all available roles.

tools.name: get_role
tools.description:
Get role details and its privileges.

Args:
    roleid: Role ID.

tools.name: create_role
tools.description:
Create a new role with specific privileges.

Args:
    roleid: Role ID.
    privs: Comma-separated list of privileges (e.g. 'VM.Allocate,VM.Config.Disk,VM.PowerMgmt').

tools.name: update_role
tools.description:
Update role privileges.

Args:
    roleid: Role ID.
    privs: Comma-separated list of privileges.
    append: Append privileges instead of replacing.

tools.name: delete_role
tools.description:
Delete a role.

Args:
    roleid: Role ID.

tools.name: get_acl
tools.description: Get the full ACL (access control list) — shows all permission assignments.

tools.name: update_acl
tools.description:
Add or remove ACL entries (permission assignments).

Args:
    path: Object path (e.g. '/', '/vms/100', '/storage/local', '/pool/mypool').
    roles: Comma-separated role list.
    users: Comma-separated user list (format: 'user@realm').
    groups: Comma-separated group list.
    tokens: Comma-separated token list (format: 'user@realm!tokenid').
    propagate: Propagate permissions to child objects.
    delete: Remove the ACL entry instead of adding.

tools.name: list_auth_domains
tools.description: List configured authentication realms/domains (PAM, PVE, LDAP, AD, OpenID).

tools.name: get_auth_domain
tools.description:
Get authentication domain configuration.

Args:
    realm: Realm ID (e.g. 'pam', 'pve', 'my-ldap').

tools.name: sync_auth_domain
tools.description:
Sync users/groups from an external auth domain (LDAP/AD).

Args:
    realm: Realm ID to sync.
    dry_run: Only show what would change.
    full: Full sync (not just incremental).
    enable_new: Enable newly synced users.
    remove_vanished: Comma-separated: 'entry' (remove users), 'properties' (clear), 'acl' (remove ACLs).

tools.name: list_tfa
tools.description:
List TFA (two-factor auth) entries.

Args:
    userid: Filter by user ID (empty = all users).

tools.name: get_permissions
tools.description:
Check effective permissions for a user on a given path.

Args:
    userid: User to check (empty = current user).
    path: Object path to check (empty = root).

tools.name: change_password
tools.description:
Change a user's password.

Args:
    userid: User ID (format: 'user@realm').
    password: New password.

tools.name: list_backup_jobs
tools.description: List all scheduled backup jobs (vzdump) in the cluster.

tools.name: get_backup_job
tools.description:
Get details of a specific backup job.

Args:
    id: Backup job ID.

tools.name: get_backup_job_included_volumes
tools.description:
Get volumes included in a backup job.

Args:
    id: Backup job ID.

tools.name: create_backup_job
tools.description:
Create a scheduled backup job.

Args:
    storage: Target storage ID for backups.
    schedule: Schedule in systemd calendar format (e.g. 'daily', 'weekly', '02:00').
    all_guests: Backup all guests.
    vmid: Comma-separated VMIDs to back up (if not all_guests).
    node: Only back up guests on this node.
    mode: Backup mode: 'snapshot', 'suspend', 'stop'.
    compress: Compression: 'none', 'lzo', 'gzip', 'zstd'.
    mailnotification: 'always' or 'failure'.
    mailto: Comma-separated email addresses.
    maxfiles: Max backup files to keep (0 = unlimited, deprecated - use prune_backups).
    prune_backups: Retention schedule (e.g. 'keep-daily=7,keep-weekly=4').
    notes_template: Template for backup notes.
    enabled: Enable the job.
    comment: Description.

tools.name: update_backup_job
tools.description:
Update a scheduled backup job.

Args:
    id: Backup job ID.
    storage: Target storage ID.
    schedule: Schedule in systemd calendar format.
    all_guests: Backup all guests.
    vmid: Comma-separated VMIDs.
    node: Node filter.
    mode: Backup mode.
    compress: Compression.
    enabled: Enable/disable.
    delete: Comma-separated properties to delete.

tools.name: delete_backup_job
tools.description:
Delete a scheduled backup job.

Args:
    id: Backup job ID.

tools.name: create_vzdump
tools.description:
Start an immediate backup (vzdump) on a node.

Args:
    node: The node to run the backup on.
    vmid: Comma-separated VMIDs (required if not all_guests).
    all_guests: Back up all guests on the node.
    storage: Target storage (empty = default).
    mode: Backup mode: 'snapshot', 'suspend', 'stop'.
    compress: Compression: 'none', 'lzo', 'gzip', 'zstd'.
    stdout: Write to stdout instead of storage.

tools.name: get_vzdump_defaults
tools.description:
Get the default vzdump configuration for a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_vzdump_extractconfig
tools.description:
Extract the guest configuration from a vzdump backup archive.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    volume: Backup volume ID (e.g. 'local:backup/vzdump-qemu-100-2024_01_01-00_00_00.vma.zst').

tools.name: list_backup_file_restore
tools.description:
List files in a vzdump backup for single-file restore.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: Storage ID.
    volume: Backup volume ID.
    filepath: Path within the backup (default '/').

tools.name: download_file_restore
tools.description:
Download a file from a vzdump backup.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: Storage ID.
    volume: Backup volume ID.
    filepath: Path of the file to download from the backup.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Get the Proxmox VE API version information.

tools.name: get_cluster_status
tools.description: Get cluster status (nodes online, quorum, HA state).

tools.name: get_cluster_resources
tools.description:
List all resources across the cluster (VMs, containers, storage, nodes).

Args:
    type: Filter by type: 'vm', 'storage', 'node', 'sdn', 'pool' (empty = all).

tools.name: get_cluster_tasks
tools.description:
List recent tasks across all nodes in the cluster.

tools.name: get_cluster_log
tools.description:
Get the cluster log (recent events).

Args:
    max_entries: Max log entries.

tools.name: get_next_vmid
tools.description:
Get the next available VMID in the cluster.

Args:
    vmid: Specific VMID to check availability for (0 = auto-assign).

tools.name: get_cluster_options
tools.description: Get datacenter/cluster-wide options (keyboard layout, console, language, etc.).

tools.description:
Update datacenter/cluster-wide options.

Args:
    keyboard: Keyboard layout (e.g. 'en-us', 'de').
    language: Default language.
    console: Default console viewer: 'applet', 'vv', 'html5', 'xtermjs'.

    email_from: Default email sender address.
    max_workers: Max parallel workers.
    description: Datacenter description.
    delete: Comma-separated settings to delete.

tools.name: get_cluster_config
tools.description: Get the current cluster configuration (corosync, nodes, join info).

tools.name: get_cluster_config_nodes
tools.description: List nodes configured in the cluster.

tools.name: get_cluster_join_info
tools.description: Get info needed to join a node to this cluster.

tools.name: join_cluster
tools.description:
Join a node to an existing cluster.

Args:
    hostname: Hostname/IP of existing cluster node.
    fingerprint: SSL fingerprint of the cluster node.
    password: Root password of the cluster node.
    nodeid: Force specific node ID.
    force: Force join even with warnings.

tools.name: get_cluster_totem
tools.description: Get the corosync totem configuration.

tools.name: list_replication_jobs
tools.description: List all replication jobs in the cluster.

tools.name: get_replication_job
tools.description:
Get a specific replication job configuration.

Args:
    id: Replication job ID (format: GUEST-JOBNUM, e.g. '100-0').

tools.name: create_replication_job
tools.description:
Create a storage replication job.

Args:
    id: Job ID (format: GUEST-JOBNUM, e.g. '100-0').
    target: Target node.
    type: Replication type (currently only 'local').
    schedule: Schedule in systemd calendar format (default '*/15' = every 15 min).
    comment: Description.
    rate: Rate limit in mbps.
    disable: Create disabled.

tools.name: delete_replication_job
tools.description:
Delete a replication job.

Args:
    id: Replication job ID.
    force: Force removal (skip cleanup).
    keep: Keep replicated data on target.

tools.name: list_metric_servers
tools.description: List configured metric servers (InfluxDB, Graphite).

tools.name: get_metric_server
tools.description:
Get metric server configuration.

Args:
    id: Metric server ID.

tools.name: list_notification_endpoints
tools.description: List all configured notification endpoints (sendmail, gotify, smtp, webhook).

tools.name: list_notification_matchers

Bulk start guests across the cluster.

tools.name: bulk_shutdown_guests

Bulk shutdown guests across the cluster.

    vms: Comma-separated list of VMIDs (empty = all).

tools.name: get_ceph_status_cluster
tools.description: Get Ceph cluster status (health, monitors, OSDs, PGs).

tools.description: Get Ceph metadata (versions, services across nodes).

Set a Ceph global flag.

List Ceph OSDs on a node.

tools.name: create_ceph_osd
tools.description:
Create a new Ceph OSD on a device.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    dev: Block device for the OSD (e.g. '/dev/sdb').

tools.name: list_ceph_pools
tools.description:
List Ceph pools.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: create_ceph_pool
tools.description:
Create a new Ceph pool.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    name: Pool name.
    size: Number of replicas (default 3).
    min_size: Minimum replicas for I/O (default 2).
    pg_num: Number of placement groups (default 128).

tools.name: list_ceph_monitors
tools.description:
List Ceph monitors.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: list_ceph_managers

List Ceph managers.

    node: The node name.

tools.name: list_ceph_mds

List Ceph metadata servers (MDS, for CephFS).

    node: The node name.

tools.name: list_ceph_fs

    node: The node name.

    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_ceph_crush_rules

    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_cluster_firewall_options
tools.description: Get cluster-wide firewall options (enable, policy_in, policy_out, etc.).

tools.name: set_cluster_firewall_options
tools.description:
Set cluster-wide firewall options.

Args:
    enable: 1 to enable, 0 to disable, -1 to not change.
    policy_in: Default input policy: 'ACCEPT', 'REJECT', 'DROP'.
    policy_out: Default output policy: 'ACCEPT', 'REJECT', 'DROP'.
    log_ratelimit: Log rate limit (e.g. 'enable=1,rate=1/second,burst=5').
    ebtables: 1 to enable ebtables rules, 0 to disable, -1 to not change.
    delete: Comma-separated options to delete.

tools.name: list_cluster_firewall_rules
tools.description: List cluster-level firewall rules.

tools.name: get_cluster_firewall_rule
tools.description:
Get a specific cluster firewall rule.

Args:
    pos: Rule position number.

tools.name: create_cluster_firewall_rule
tools.description:
Create a cluster-level firewall rule.

Args:
    action: 'ACCEPT', 'DROP', 'REJECT'.
    type: 'in', 'out', 'group'.
    enable: 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled.
    source: Source address/range (CIDR or alias).
    dest: Destination address/range.
    proto: Protocol (tcp, udp, icmp, etc.).
    sport: Source port(s).
    dport: Destination port(s).
    iface: Network interface.
    macro: Use predefined macro (e.g. 'SSH', 'HTTP', 'HTTPS', 'Ping').
    comment: Description.
    log: Log level: 'emerg', 'alert', 'crit', 'err', 'warning', 'notice', 'info', 'debug', 'nolog'.
    pos: Rule position (-1 = append).

tools.name: update_cluster_firewall_rule
tools.description:
Update a cluster-level firewall rule.

Args:
    pos: Rule position to update.
    action: 'ACCEPT', 'DROP', 'REJECT'.
    enable: 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled, -1 = don't change.
    source: Source address/range.
    dest: Destination address/range.
    proto: Protocol.
    sport: Source port(s).
    dport: Destination port(s).
    macro: Predefined macro.
    comment: Description.
    moveto: Move rule to this position.
    delete: Comma-separated properties to delete.

tools.name: delete_cluster_firewall_rule
tools.description:
Delete a cluster-level firewall rule.

Args:
    pos: Rule position to delete.

tools.name: list_firewall_groups

tools.name: get_firewall_group_rules

tools.name: create_firewall_group_rule

    type: 'in', 'out'.
    enable: 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled.
    source: Source address/range.
    dest: Destination address/range.
    proto: Protocol.
    sport: Source port(s).
    dport: Destination port(s).
    macro: Predefined macro.
    comment: Description.

tools.name: list_firewall_aliases

tools.name: delete_firewall_ipset_entry

tools.name: list_node_firewall_rules

    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_firewall_log
tools.description:
Get firewall log for a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: relocate_ha_resource

tools.name: get_ha_group
tools.description:
Get HA group configuration.

Update an HA group.

    group: Group ID.

tools.name: delete_ha_group

Delete an HA group.

    group: Group ID.

tools.name: list_containers
tools.description:
List all LXC containers on a node with status, memory, CPU, and disk info.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_container_status
tools.description:
Get the current runtime status of a container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID (CTID).

tools.name: get_container_config
tools.description:
Get the configuration of a container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.

tools.name: get_container_pending
tools.description:
Get pending configuration changes for a container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.

tools.name: get_container_interfaces
tools.description:
Get network interfaces and IPs of a running container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.

tools.name: get_container_rrddata
tools.description:
Get RRD statistics data for a container (CPU, memory, disk, network over time).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    timeframe: Time range: 'hour', 'day', 'week', 'month', 'year'.

tools.name: get_container_feature
tools.description:
Check if a feature is available for a container (snapshot, clone, copy).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    feature: Feature to check ('snapshot', 'clone', 'copy').

tools.name: create_container
tools.description:
Create a new LXC container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    ostemplate: Template volume (e.g. 'local:vztmpl/debian-12-standard_12.2-1_amd64.tar.zst').
    hostname: Container hostname.
    password: Root password.
    ssh_public_keys: SSH public keys (newline delimited).
    storage: Storage for rootfs (default 'local').
    rootfs: Root filesystem spec (e.g. 'local-lvm:8' for 8GB).
    memory: Memory in MB (default 512).
    swap: Swap in MB (default 512).
    cores: CPU cores (default 1).
    cpulimit: CPU limit (0 = unlimited).
    net0: Network config (e.g. 'name=eth0,bridge=vmbr0,ip=dhcp').
    nameserver: DNS nameserver.
    searchdomain: DNS search domain.
    onboot: Start on host boot.
    start: Start after creation.
    unprivileged: Create an unprivileged container (default True, recommended).
    features: Comma-separated features (e.g. 'nesting=1,keyctl=1').
    description: Container description.
    pool: Resource pool.
    tags: Semicolon-separated tags.
    mp0: Mount point (e.g. 'local-lvm:4,mp=/mnt/data').

tools.name: update_container_config
tools.description:
Update the configuration of an existing container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    hostname: Container hostname.
    memory: Memory in MB.
    swap: Swap in MB.
    cores: CPU cores.
    cpulimit: CPU limit (0 = unlimited).
    net0: Network config.
    nameserver: DNS nameserver.
    searchdomain: DNS search domain.
    onboot: Start on boot.
    description: Description.
    features: Comma-separated features.
    tags: Semicolon-separated tags.
    delete: Comma-separated list of settings to delete.

tools.name: delete_container
tools.description:
Delete a container. Must be stopped first unless force=True.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    purge: Remove from replication, HA, backup and ACLs too.
    destroy_unreferenced_disks: Destroy unreferenced disks.
    force: Force destroy even if running.

tools.name: start_container
tools.description:
Start a container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.

tools.name: stop_container
tools.description:
Hard-stop a container (immediate, like power off).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.

tools.name: shutdown_container
tools.description:
Gracefully shut down a container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    timeout: Timeout in seconds before force stop.
    force_stop: Force stop after timeout.

tools.name: reboot_container
tools.description:
Reboot a container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    timeout: Timeout in seconds.

tools.name: suspend_container
tools.description:
Suspend (freeze) a container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.

tools.name: resume_container
tools.description:
Resume a suspended container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.

tools.name: clone_container
tools.description:
Clone a container.

Args:
    node: The source node name.
    vmid: The source container ID.
    newid: ID for the new container.
    hostname: Hostname for the clone.
    target: Target node (default: same node).
    full: Full clone (True) or linked clone (False).
    storage: Target storage for full clone.
    description: Description.
    pool: Resource pool.
    snapname: Snapshot to clone from.

tools.name: migrate_container
tools.description:
Migrate a container to another node.

Args:
    node: The source node.
    vmid: The container ID.
    target: Target node name.
    online: Live migration.
    restart: Restart container after migration (for non-live).
    target_storage: Target storage mapping.

tools.name: convert_container_to_template
tools.description:
Convert a container into a template (irreversible).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.

tools.name: resize_container_disk
tools.description:
Resize a container disk/volume.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    disk: Disk name (e.g. 'rootfs', 'mp0').
    size: New size or increment (e.g. '10G', '+2G').

tools.name: move_container_volume
tools.description:
Move a container volume to different storage or to another container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    volume: Volume name (e.g. 'rootfs', 'mp0').
    storage: Target storage.
    target_vmid: Target container ID.
    target_volume: Target volume slot.
    delete_original: Delete original after move.

tools.name: list_container_snapshots
tools.description:
List all snapshots of a container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.

tools.name: create_container_snapshot
tools.description:
Create a snapshot of a container.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    snapname: Snapshot name.
    description: Snapshot description.

tools.name: delete_container_snapshot
tools.description:
Delete a container snapshot.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    snapname: Snapshot name.
    force: Force delete.

tools.name: rollback_container_snapshot
tools.description:
Rollback a container to a previous snapshot.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The container ID.
    snapname: Snapshot name.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: List all nodes in the Proxmox cluster with their status, CPU, memory, and uptime.

tools.name: get_node_status
tools.description:
Get detailed status of a specific node including CPU, memory, disk, uptime, and kernel info.

Args:
    node: The node name (e.g. 'pve1').

tools.name: get_node_config
tools.description:
Get the configuration of a node (description, wakeonlan, etc.).

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_dns
tools.description:
Get DNS settings for a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_network
tools.description:
Get network interface configuration for a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_network_interface
tools.description:
Get details for a specific network interface.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    iface: Interface name (e.g. 'vmbr0', 'eth0').

tools.name: create_node_network_interface
tools.description:
Create a network interface on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    iface: Interface name (e.g. 'vmbr1').
    type: Interface type (bridge, bond, eth, alias, vlan, OVSBridge, OVSPort, OVSIntPort, OVSBond).
    address: IP address (CIDR notation or IP).
    netmask: Subnet mask.
    gateway: Default gateway.
    bridge_ports: Bridge ports (for bridge type).
    autostart: Whether to start on boot.
    comments: Comments for the interface.

tools.name: list_node_services
tools.description:
List all system services on a node (pve, ssh, cron, etc.).

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: manage_node_service
tools.description:
Start, stop, restart, or reload a system service on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    service: Service name (e.g. 'pvedaemon', 'pveproxy', 'ssh', 'cron', 'postfix').
    action: One of 'start', 'stop', 'restart', 'reload'.

tools.name: get_node_syslog
tools.description:
Read system log (syslog) entries from a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    limit: Max number of log lines to return (default 50).
    start: Start line number.
    since: Only show entries since this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
    until: Only show entries until this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_node_journal
tools.description:
Read systemd journal entries from a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    lastentries: Max number of entries (default 50).
    since: Show entries since date/time.
    until: Show entries until date/time.
    startcursor: Start cursor for paging.

tools.name: list_node_tasks
tools.description:
List recent tasks on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    limit: Max tasks to return (default 50).
    start: Offset for paging.
    vmid: Filter by VM ID (0 = all).
    typefilter: Filter by task type (e.g. 'qmstart', 'vzstart', 'vzcreate').
    statusfilter: Filter by status ('running', 'ok', 'error', etc.).

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description:
Get the status of a specific task by its UPID.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    upid: The task UPID string.

tools.name: get_task_log
tools.description:
Get log output of a specific task.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    upid: The task UPID string.
    limit: Max lines to return.
    start: Start line number.

tools.name: stop_task
tools.description:
Stop (abort) a running task.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    upid: The task UPID string.

tools.name: get_node_time
tools.description:
Get the current time and timezone of a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_subscription
tools.description:
Get subscription status for a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_apt_update
tools.description:
List available package updates on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: run_apt_update
tools.description:
Refresh the package index on a node (apt update).

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_report
tools.description:
Generate a system report for a node (useful for diagnostics).

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_disks
tools.description:
List physical disks on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_disk_smart
tools.description:
Get S.M.A.R.T. health data for a disk.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    disk: Disk device path (e.g. '/dev/sda').

tools.name: get_node_hardware_pci
tools.description:
List PCI hardware devices on a node (for passthrough).

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_hardware_usb
tools.description:
List USB hardware devices on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_capabilities_qemu
tools.description:
Get QEMU capabilities for a node: supported CPU models, machine types, etc.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_storage_scan
tools.description:
Scan for available storage targets (NFS, CIFS, iSCSI, LVM, ZFS, PBS).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    scan_type: Type to scan: 'nfs', 'cifs', 'iscsi', 'lvm', 'lvmthin', 'zfs', 'pbs'.
    server: Server address (required for nfs, cifs, iscsi, pbs).

tools.name: wakeonlan_node
tools.description:
Send a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: startall_node
tools.description:
Start all VMs and containers on a node (respecting boot order).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    force: Force start even if already running.
    vms: Comma-separated list of VMIDs to start (empty = all).

tools.name: stopall_node
tools.description:
Stop all VMs and containers on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vms: Comma-separated list of VMIDs to stop (empty = all).

tools.name: get_node_hosts
tools.description:
Get the /etc/hosts file content for a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_version
tools.description:
Get Proxmox VE version information for a specific node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_netstat
tools.description:
Get network statistics for a node (per-interface traffic).

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_node_aplinfo
tools.description:
List available appliance templates (LXC templates) that can be downloaded.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: download_appliance_template
tools.description:
Download an appliance template to local storage.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: Target storage ID.
    template: Template name to download.

tools.name: list_pools
tools.description: List all resource pools.

tools.name: get_pool
tools.description:
Get pool configuration and members.

Args:
    poolid: Pool ID.

tools.name: create_pool
tools.description:
Create a resource pool.

Args:
    poolid: Pool ID.
    comment: Description.

tools.name: update_pool
tools.description:
Update a resource pool (add/remove members).

Args:
    poolid: Pool ID.
    comment: Description.
    vms: Comma-separated VMIDs to add/remove.
    storage: Comma-separated storage IDs to add/remove.
    delete: If true, remove the specified vms/storage from the pool instead of adding.

tools.name: delete_pool
tools.description:
Delete a resource pool.

Args:
    poolid: Pool ID.

tools.name: list_acme_accounts
tools.description: List ACME (Let's Encrypt) accounts.

tools.name: get_acme_account
tools.description:
Get ACME account details.

Args:
    name: Account name (default: 'default').

tools.name: register_acme_account
tools.description:
Register a new ACME account.

Args:
    contact: Contact email address.
    directory: ACME directory URL (empty = Let's Encrypt production).
    name: Account name.
    tos_url: Terms of service URL to accept.

tools.name: list_acme_plugins
tools.description: List ACME DNS challenge plugins.

tools.name: get_acme_plugin
tools.description:
Get ACME plugin configuration.

Args:
    id: Plugin ID.

tools.name: get_acme_directories
tools.description: List known ACME directory URLs.

tools.name: get_acme_tos
tools.description: Get the ACME Terms of Service URL.

tools.name: order_node_certificate
tools.description:
Order/renew ACME certificate for a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    force: Force renewal even if not due.

tools.name: get_node_certificates
tools.description:
Get certificate info for a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: list_vms
tools.description:
List all QEMU virtual machines on a node with status, memory, CPU, and disk info.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_vm_status
tools.description:
Get the current runtime status of a VM (state, CPU, memory, disk, network, uptime).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.

tools.name: get_vm_config
tools.description:
Get the configuration of a VM.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    current: If True, return current (runtime) config. If False, return pending config.

tools.name: get_vm_pending
tools.description:
Get pending configuration changes for a VM (not yet applied).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.

tools.name: get_vm_feature
tools.description:
Check if a specific feature is available/supported for a VM (e.g. snapshot, clone, copy).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    feature: Feature to check ('snapshot', 'clone', 'copy').

tools.name: get_vm_rrddata
tools.description:
Get RRD statistics data for a VM (CPU, memory, disk, network over time).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    timeframe: Time range: 'hour', 'day', 'week', 'month', 'year'.

tools.name: create_vm
tools.description:
Create a new QEMU virtual machine.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID number.
    name: VM name.
    memory: Memory in MB (default 2048).
    cores: Number of CPU cores per socket (default 1).
    sockets: Number of CPU sockets (default 1).
    cpu: CPU type (default 'host').
    ostype: OS type: l26 (Linux 2.6+), win10, win11, wxp, other, etc.
    scsihw: SCSI controller: virtio-scsi-single, virtio-scsi-pci, lsi, megasas, pvscsi.
    scsi0: First SCSI disk (e.g. 'local-lvm:32' for 32GB on local-lvm).
    ide2: IDE device, often used for CD-ROM (e.g. 'local:iso/ubuntu.iso,media=cdrom').
    net0: Network device (e.g. 'virtio,bridge=vmbr0').
    boot: Boot order (e.g. 'order=scsi0;ide2;net0').
    bios: BIOS type: seabios, ovmf (UEFI).
    machine: Machine type (e.g. 'q35', 'i440fx').
    cdrom: CD-ROM ISO image path.
    agent: QEMU guest agent: '1' to enable, 'enabled=1,fstrim_cloned_disks=1'.
    start: Start the VM after creation.
    onboot: Start on host boot.
    description: VM description.
    pool: Resource pool to add the VM to.
    tags: Semicolon-separated tags.

tools.name: update_vm_config
tools.description:
Update the configuration of an existing VM. Only provided parameters are changed.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    name: VM name.
    memory: Memory in MB.
    cores: CPU cores per socket.
    sockets: CPU sockets.
    cpu: CPU type.
    net0: Network config.
    description: Description.
    onboot: Start on boot.
    agent: Guest agent config.
    boot: Boot order.
    tags: Semicolon-separated tags.
    hotplug: Hotplug features (disk, network, usb, memory, cpu).
    delete: Comma-separated list of settings to delete.

tools.name: delete_vm
tools.description:
Delete a VM. The VM must be stopped first.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    purge: Remove from replication, HA, backup jobs and ACLs too.
    destroy_unreferenced_disks: Also destroy unreferenced disks owned by the VM.

tools.name: start_vm
tools.description:
Start a VM.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    timeout: Timeout in seconds (0 = default).

tools.name: stop_vm
tools.description:
Hard-stop a VM (like pulling the power plug). Prefer shutdown_vm for graceful stop.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    timeout: Wait timeout in seconds.
    skiplock: Ignore locks (requires root).

tools.name: shutdown_vm
tools.description:
Gracefully shut down a VM via ACPI. Falls back to hard stop after timeout if force_stop is true.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    timeout: Timeout in seconds before force stop.
    force_stop: Force stop after timeout (default True).

tools.name: reboot_vm
tools.description:
Reboot a VM via ACPI.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    timeout: Wait timeout in seconds.

tools.name: suspend_vm
tools.description:
Suspend a VM (pause execution or hibernate to disk).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    todisk: If True, hibernate to disk. If False, pause in RAM.

tools.name: resume_vm
tools.description:
Resume a suspended/paused VM.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.

tools.name: reset_vm
tools.description:
Hard reset a VM (like pressing the reset button).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.

tools.name: clone_vm
tools.description:
Clone a VM to create a new one. Can be a full copy or linked clone.

Args:
    node: The source node name.
    vmid: The source VM ID.
    newid: The VMID for the new clone.
    name: Name for the clone.
    target: Target node for the clone (default: same node).
    full: Full clone (True) or linked clone (False).
    storage: Target storage for full clone.
    description: Description for the clone.
    pool: Resource pool.
    snapname: Snapshot name to clone from.

tools.name: migrate_vm
tools.description:
Migrate a VM to another node in the cluster.

Args:
    node: The source node.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    target: Target node name.
    online: Live migration (True) or offline (False).
    with_local_disks: Migrate local disks as well.
    targetstorage: Target storage mapping for migration (e.g. 'local-lvm').

tools.name: convert_vm_to_template
tools.description:
Convert a VM into a template (irreversible).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.

tools.name: resize_vm_disk
tools.description:
Resize a VM disk. Can only grow, not shrink.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    disk: Disk name (e.g. 'scsi0', 'virtio0', 'ide0').
    size: New size or size increment (e.g. '50G', '+10G').

tools.name: move_vm_disk
tools.description:
Move a VM disk to different storage or attach to another VM.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    disk: Source disk name (e.g. 'scsi0').
    storage: Target storage ID (for moving to different storage).
    target_vmid: Target VM ID (for moving disk to another VM).
    target_disk: Target disk slot on the target VM.
    delete_original: Delete the original disk after moving.

tools.name: list_vm_snapshots
tools.description:
List all snapshots of a VM.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.

tools.name: create_vm_snapshot
tools.description:
Create a snapshot of a VM.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    snapname: Snapshot name.
    description: Snapshot description.
    vmstate: Include RAM state (for running VMs).

tools.name: delete_vm_snapshot
tools.description:
Delete a VM snapshot.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    snapname: Snapshot name to delete.
    force: Force delete even if snapshot is in use.

tools.name: rollback_vm_snapshot
tools.description:
Rollback a VM to a previous snapshot (current state will be lost).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    snapname: The snapshot name to rollback to.

tools.name: get_vm_snapshot_config
tools.description:
Get the configuration stored in a VM snapshot.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    snapname: The snapshot name.

tools.name: get_vm_cloudinit
tools.description:
Get Cloud-Init configuration for a VM.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.

tools.name: update_vm_cloudinit
tools.description:
Set Cloud-Init parameters for a VM (user, password, SSH keys, network).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    ciuser: Cloud-Init user name.
    cipassword: Cloud-Init password.
    sshkeys: SSH public keys (URL-encoded, newline delimited).
    ipconfig0: IP config for first interface (e.g. 'ip=dhcp' or 'ip=10.0.0.5/24,gw=10.0.0.1').
    nameserver: DNS nameserver IP.
    searchdomain: DNS search domain.

tools.name: dump_vm_cloudinit
tools.description:
Dump the Cloud-Init generated config file (user-data, network-data, or meta-data).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    type: Config type: 'user', 'network', or 'meta'.

tools.name: vm_agent_exec
tools.description:
Execute a command inside a VM via the QEMU Guest Agent.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    command: The command to execute.
    input_data: Data to pass to stdin.

tools.name: vm_agent_exec_status
tools.description:
Get the status/result of a command previously executed via the guest agent.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    pid: The PID returned by the exec call.

tools.name: vm_agent_file_read
tools.description:
Read a file from inside a VM via the guest agent.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    file: Absolute file path inside the guest.

tools.name: vm_agent_file_write
tools.description:
Write content to a file inside a VM via the guest agent.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    file: Absolute file path inside the guest.
    content: File content to write.

tools.name: vm_agent_get_info
tools.description:
Get various system information from a VM via the guest agent.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    info_type: Info to retrieve: 'get-osinfo', 'get-host-name', 'get-time',
               'get-timezone', 'get-users', 'get-vcpus', 'get-fsinfo',
               'get-memory-blocks', 'get-memory-block-info', 'info',
               'network-get-interfaces'.

tools.name: vm_agent_set_password
tools.description:
Set a user password inside a VM via the guest agent.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    username: The username.
    password: The new password.
    crypted: If True, password is already encrypted.

tools.name: get_vm_vncproxy
tools.description:
Create a VNC proxy connection ticket for a VM (for console access).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    websocket: Use WebSocket connection.

tools.name: get_vm_spiceproxy
tools.description:
Create a SPICE proxy connection for a VM console.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.

tools.name: send_vm_key
tools.description:
Send a key event to a VM (e.g. ctrl-alt-del).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    key: Key combination (e.g. 'ctrl-alt-delete').

tools.name: send_vm_monitor_command
tools.description:
Send a QEMU monitor command to a VM (advanced/low-level).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    vmid: The VM ID.
    command: The QEMU monitor command.

tools.name: list_sdn_vnets
tools.description: List SDN virtual networks (VNets).

tools.name: get_sdn_vnet
tools.description:
Get SDN VNet configuration.

Args:
    vnet: VNet ID.

tools.name: create_sdn_vnet
tools.description:
Create an SDN VNet.

Args:
    vnet: VNet ID.
    zone: Zone ID.
    tag: VLAN tag.
    alias: Display alias.
    vlanaware: Enable VLAN-aware bridge.

tools.name: update_sdn_vnet
tools.description:
Update an SDN VNet.

Args:
    vnet: VNet ID.
    zone: Zone ID.
    tag: VLAN tag (-1 = don't change).
    alias: Display alias.
    delete: Comma-separated properties to delete.

tools.name: delete_sdn_vnet
tools.description:
Delete an SDN VNet.

Args:
    vnet: VNet ID.

tools.name: list_sdn_subnets
tools.description:
List subnets for an SDN VNet.

Args:
    vnet: VNet ID.

tools.name: create_sdn_subnet
tools.description:
Create a subnet for an SDN VNet.

Args:
    vnet: VNet ID.
    subnet: Subnet CIDR (e.g. '10.0.0.0/24').
    gateway: Gateway IP.
    snat: Enable SNAT.
    dnszoneprefix: DNS zone prefix.

tools.name: list_sdn_zones
tools.description: List SDN zones.

tools.name: get_sdn_zone
tools.description:
Get SDN zone configuration.

Args:
    zone: Zone ID.

tools.name: create_sdn_zone
tools.description:
Create an SDN zone.

Args:
    zone: Zone ID.
    type: Zone type: 'simple', 'vlan', 'qinq', 'vxlan', 'evpn'.
    nodes: Comma-separated node list.
    ipam: IPAM plugin name.
    dns: DNS plugin name.
    bridge: Bridge name.
    mtu: MTU.

tools.name: delete_sdn_zone
tools.description:
Delete an SDN zone.

Args:
    zone: Zone ID.

tools.name: list_sdn_controllers
tools.description: List SDN controllers (e.g. EVPN controller).

tools.name: get_sdn_controller
tools.description:
Get SDN controller configuration.

Args:
    controller: Controller ID.

tools.name: list_sdn_ipams
tools.description: List IPAM (IP Address Management) plugins.

tools.name: get_sdn_ipam
tools.description:
Get IPAM plugin configuration.

Args:
    ipam: IPAM ID.

tools.name: list_sdn_dns
tools.description: List SDN DNS plugins.

tools.name: apply_sdn_changes
tools.description: Apply pending SDN configuration changes to all nodes.

tools.name: list_storage
tools.description:
List all configured storage pools at the datacenter level.

Args:
    type: Filter by type (dir, lvm, lvmthin, zfspool, nfs, cifs, iscsi, rbd, cephfs, pbs, glusterfs, btrfs).
    enabled: Only show enabled storage (default True).

tools.name: get_storage_config
tools.description:
Get configuration of a specific storage pool.

Args:
    storage: The storage ID.

tools.name: create_storage
tools.description:
Create a new storage pool configuration.

Args:
    storage: Storage ID.
    type: Storage type: dir, lvm, lvmthin, zfspool, nfs, cifs, iscsi, rbd, cephfs, pbs, glusterfs, btrfs.
    path: File system path (for dir, nfs mounts).
    server: Server IP/hostname (for nfs, cifs, iscsi, pbs, glusterfs, rbd, cephfs).
    export: NFS export path.
    vgname: LVM volume group name.
    thinpool: LVM thin pool name (for lvmthin).
    pool: Pool name (for Ceph RBD/CephFS, ZFS).
    portal: iSCSI portal.
    target: iSCSI target.
    datastore: PBS datastore name.
    content: Comma-separated content types (images, rootdir, vztmpl, iso, backup, snippets, import).
    nodes: Restrict storage to these nodes (comma-separated).
    shared: Mark as shared storage.
    disable: Create disabled.
    maxfiles: Max backup files (0 = unlimited).
    prune_backups: Backup retention policy.

tools.name: update_storage
tools.description:
Update an existing storage pool configuration.

Args:
    storage: The storage ID to update.
    content: Content types (images, rootdir, vztmpl, iso, backup, snippets, import).
    nodes: Allowed nodes (comma-separated).
    shared: Mark as shared.
    disable: Disable this storage.
    prune_backups: Backup retention policy.
    delete: Comma-separated list of settings to delete.

tools.name: delete_storage
tools.description:
Delete a storage pool configuration (does not delete data on the backend).

Args:
    storage: The storage ID.

tools.name: list_node_storage
tools.description:
List storage pools available on a specific node with usage info.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    content: Filter by content type (images, rootdir, vztmpl, iso, backup).
    enabled: Only show enabled storage.

tools.name: get_node_storage_status
tools.description:
Get usage status of a storage pool on a node (total, used, available).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: The storage ID.

tools.name: list_storage_content
tools.description:
List content of a storage pool (disk images, ISOs, templates, backups).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: The storage ID.
    content: Filter by type: 'images', 'rootdir', 'vztmpl', 'iso', 'backup', 'snippets'.
    vmid: Filter by VM ID.

tools.name: get_storage_volume_info
tools.description:
Get details about a specific volume in storage.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: The storage ID.
    volume: The volume ID.

tools.name: allocate_storage_volume
tools.description:
Allocate a new disk volume in storage.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: The storage ID.
    vmid: VM ID to associate with.
    filename: Volume name.
    size: Volume size (e.g. '10G').
    format: Disk format (raw, qcow2, vmdk). Auto-detected if empty.

tools.name: delete_storage_volume
tools.description:
Delete a volume from storage.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: The storage ID.
    volume: The volume ID.

tools.name: upload_to_storage
tools.description:
Upload a file (ISO, template, etc.) to storage. Note: actual file upload must go through the HTTP API directly.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: The storage ID.
    content: Content type: 'iso', 'vztmpl', 'snippets', 'import'.
    filename: Target filename.
    tmpfilename: Temporary filename for the upload.

tools.name: download_url_to_storage
tools.description:
Download a file from a URL directly to storage (ISO, template, etc.).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: The storage ID.
    url: URL to download from.
    content: Content type: 'iso', 'vztmpl'.
    filename: Target filename.
    checksum: Expected checksum.
    checksum_algorithm: Checksum algorithm (sha256, sha512, md5).

tools.name: get_storage_rrddata
tools.description:
Get RRD statistics for a storage pool (usage over time).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: The storage ID.
    timeframe: Time range: 'hour', 'day', 'week', 'month', 'year'.

tools.name: prune_storage_backups
tools.description:
Prune (delete) old backups from storage according to retention policy.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: The storage ID.
    type: Guest type filter ('qemu' or 'lxc').
    vmid: Filter by VM ID.
    prune_backups: Retention spec (e.g. 'keep-last=3,keep-daily=7,keep-weekly=4').
    dry_run: If True, only simulate (default True for safety).

tools.name: list_file_restore
tools.description:
List files in a backup volume for file-level restore (PBS backups).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    storage: The storage ID.
    volume: The backup volume ID.
    filepath: Path inside the backup to list (default '/').

tools.name: list_lvm_volumes
tools.description:
List LVM volume groups on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: create_lvm
tools.description:
Create a new LVM volume group on a device.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    name: VG name.
    device: Block device path (e.g. '/dev/sdb').
    add_to_storage: Auto-add as Proxmox storage.

tools.name: list_lvmthin_pools
tools.description:
List LVM thin pools on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: create_lvmthin
tools.description:
Create a new LVM thin pool.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    name: Thin pool name.
    device: Block device path.
    add_to_storage: Auto-add as Proxmox storage.

tools.name: list_zfs_pools
tools.description:
List ZFS pools on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: get_zfs_pool
tools.description:
Get details of a ZFS pool.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    name: ZFS pool name.

tools.name: create_zfs_pool
tools.description:
Create a new ZFS pool.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    name: Pool name.
    raidlevel: RAID level: single, mirror, raid10, raidz, raidz2, raidz3, draid, draid2, draid3.
    devices: Space-separated device paths (e.g. '/dev/sdb /dev/sdc').
    add_to_storage: Auto-add as Proxmox storage.
    ashift: ashift value (default 12).
    compression: Compression (on, off, lz4, zstd, etc.).

tools.name: list_directory_storage
tools.description:
List directory-based storage mounts on a node.

Args:
    node: The node name.

tools.name: create_directory_storage
tools.description:
Create a directory-based storage mount from a device.

Args:
    node: The node name.
    name: Storage name.
    device: Block device path.
    filesystem: Filesystem type (ext4, xfs).
    add_to_storage: Auto-add as Proxmox storage.

tools.name: initialize_gpt
tools.description:
Initialize a disk with GPT partition table (WARNING: destroys all data).

Args:
    node: The node name.
    disk: Disk device path (e.g. '/dev/sdb').

tools.name: proxmox_api_raw
tools.description:
Make an arbitrary Proxmox API call for any endpoint not covered by specific tools.

Args:
    method: HTTP method: 'get', 'post', 'put', 'delete'.
    path: API path (e.g. '/nodes/pve1/qemu/100/status/current').
    params: JSON string of parameters (e.g. '{"memory": 4096}').
